title: Noise Adaptive Streaming Audio-Visual Speech Token Enhancement for Robust Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.08390v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but their audio-only perception often fails under background noise and overlapping speech, leading to incoherent responses. Recent audio-visual dialogue approaches show that incorporating visual cues such as lip movements improve robustness under audio corruption. However, existing approaches often adapt the large speech dialogue model itself to process visual input, requiring costly multimodal training. We propose AV-STE, a modular streaming audio-visual front-end that restores corrupted semantic speech tokens from noisy audio and lip video before they reach the speech LLM. The downstream dialogue model remains entirely frozen, preserving its pretrained conversational capabilities. translated_title: 面向鲁棒全双工口语对话模型的噪声自适应流式音视频语音词元增强
translated_abstract: 全双工口语对话系统能够同时进行听和说，但其纯音频的感知方式在背景噪声和语音重叠的情况下常常失效，导致回复不连贯。近期的音视频对话方法表明，融入唇部动作等视觉线索可以提高音频受损时的鲁棒性。然而，现有方法通常需要调整大型语音对话模型本身来处理视觉输入，这需要昂贵的多模态训练。我们提出了AV-STE，一个模块化的流式音视频前端，它在含噪音频和唇部视频到达语音大语言模型之前，恢复受损的语义语音词元。下游对话模型保持完全冻结，从而保留其预训练的对话能力。当与冻结的Moshi集成时，AV-STE在同数据集说话人干扰条件下，将GPT-4o评判的平均回复连贯性从1.42提升到1.91，同时基本保留了原有的对话能力。
tldr: 提出模块化流式音视频前端AV-STE，在语义语音词元进入完全冻结的语音大模型之前，利用含噪音频与唇部视频恢复受损词元，无需昂贵的多模态训练即可显著提升全双工口语对话系统在噪声与语音重叠下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: AV-STE, a modular streaming audio-visual front-end, restores corrupted semantic speech tokens from noisy audio and lip video before they reach a fully frozen speech LLM, significantly improving the robustness of full-duplex spoken dialogue systems against noise and overlapping speech without costly multimodal training.
